component.name: PresenceJam
component.summary: Syncs Spotify playback to your Microsoft Teams status

description.p: PresenceJam keeps your Microsoft Teams status message in step with what you are playing on Spotify. Connect both accounts once and the status updates on its own: artist, track, album and a per-track emoji, with quiet hours and per-track rules when you want the status left alone.
It runs in the system tray, needs no admin rights, keeps Spotify and Microsoft credentials in your desktop keychain, and updates itself from signed release artefacts.

screenshot.caption: The dashboard: current track, sync state and the status being published

description.p: Dependency refresh: the grouped Rust/Tauri, npm and GitHub Actions minor-and-patch updates, with tauri-plugin-deep-link held at 2.6.3 because 2.6.2 does not compile against rust-ini 0.21.3. No application behaviour changed.

PresenceJam now knows more about whether you are busy than you do. Named presence profiles switchable from the tray, a hotkey or the command line; track rules that match album, show, device, playlist and duration and can explain why they did or did not fire; an Outlook calendar pre-gate that suppresses the status write during a meeting and un-gates within one poll of the end; working-hours import into quiet-hours rules; a status-decision history on the Dashboard; volume, seek and the documented playback capability flags; a manual status composer with expiry; and a headless daemon with a token-guarded localhost control API, packaged for systemd, launchd and Task Scheduler.
Spotify-to-Teams status sync, quiet hours, per-track status rules, the deferred install-on-quit update path and a redacted diagnostics snapshot for support.
